wiki00892.title: How to Offset the Carbon Footprint of Flying2
wiki00892.text: Newer planes are often more fuel efficient and as a result newer airlines often have lower carbon emissions. In order to compare the carbon emissions of different airlines, use Google's ITA Matrix software. Although the site was developed to find cheap flights, it also provides consumers with the carbon emissions for each flight. You can simply choose the airline with the lowest carbon emissions., A great way to reduce the carbon emissions of air travel is by combining trips. If you are required to go to New York City for business you could schedule multiple meetings in order to save trips. Alternatively, if you need to go to Shanghai for business you could try extending your trip and adding some personal time. This way you can avoid revisiting the same place twice: once for business and once for pleasure., Take-offs and landings use the most fuel. As a result, you should always take the most direct route possible when travelling by air. Even though you may be able to find cheaper flights with layovers, you are actually increasing the carbon emissions significantly., If you have to fly, make sure that you purchase economy class tickets. These seats are closer together allowing more people to fit on each flight, ultimately reducing the carbon emissions per passenger.This also means that you should avoid flying on private planes, which only transport a few people, but still burn a lot of fuel. Similarly, you should avoid any unnecessary air travel, such as a helicopter ride while on vacation.

# Structured Summary of Talent Casting System

## Overview
This system is designed to facilitate the casting process for roles in movies, advertisements, and other media events. It involves matching project requirements with the talents in a database, creating call lists for agents, preparing submission lists for casting directors, informing performers about auditions, and handling the submission of performers' materials.

## Detailed Step-by-Step Representation

### START:
- Begin the casting process for a new project.

- INPUT: Receive the project description.
- OUTPUT: Print out the project description.

- IF the role calls for union performers:
  - PROCESS: Search for Union Talent
    - INPUT: Use the project description to filter for union talent in the database.
    - STORE: Store the list of union talent.
- ELSE IF the role calls for non-union performers:
  - PROCESS: Search for Non-Union Talent
    - INPUT: Use the project description to filter for non-union talent in the database.
    - STORE: Store the list of non-union talent.
- ELSE:

    - INPUT: Use the project description to search for any relevant talent in the database.
    - STORE: Store the list of relevant talent.

### OUTPUT: Call List for Agent
- PROCESS: Generate Call List
  - INPUT: Retrieve head shot thumbnails and phone numbers from the database.
  - OUTPUT: Print a call list for the agent with head shot thumbnails and phone numbers.

### OUTPUT: Submission List for Casting Director
- PROCESS: Generate Submission List
  - INPUT: Omit contact info from the call list.
  - OUTPUT: Print a submission list without contact info for the casting director.

### PROCESS: Inform Performers
- PROCESS: Contact Performers
  - INPUT: Performer contact information.
  - OUTPUT: Contact each performer by phone or email with audition details.

### INPUT: Sides (Audition Material)

### PROCESS: Collaboration
- INPUT: Engage in chats with other collaborators while working on documents.
- STORE: Maintain communication for collaborative work.

# Propane Grill Ignition System

## Summary Representation of the Blog Post on How to Start a Propane Grill

START: 
  - Begin the process of starting a propane grill.

PROCESS: Check Hose Fitting
  - Ensure the fitting for the hoses is tight.
  - Confirm there is no smell of gas leaking.

PROCESS: Check Propane Level
  - Check the propane tank gauge to determine if there is enough propane.
  - Refer to the grill's user manual for secure connection guidelines.

PROCESS: Open Valve
  - Slowly turn the valve to fully open it.
  - Leave open for approximately one minute to allow gas to travel through the fuel line.

PROCESS: Turn On First Burner
  - Turn the knob on the grill's front to the "High/Start" setting for the first burner.

DECISION [IF]: Is Igniter Button Working?
  - IF Yes: Press the igniter button to ignite the gas.
    - OUTPUT: Gas is ignited.
  - IF No: Proceed to manual lighting.
    - PROCESS: Light Burner Manually
      - Hold a lit match against the burner with the gas on.
      - Turn the knob to "High/Start."
      - OUTPUT: Burner should ignite.
    - DECISION [IF]: Did Burner Ignite Within Ten Seconds?
      - IF Yes: Proceed to light other burners.
      - IF No: Turn off the gas and wait a few minutes before retrying.
        - OUTPUT: Safety measure to prevent propane accumulation.

PROCESS: Ignite Remaining Burners
  - Turn the knob for each remaining burner to the "High/Start" position.
  - DECISION [IF]: Do New Burners Ignite From First Burner?
    - IF Yes: Continue to heating the grill.
    - IF No: Press the igniter button again or use a long match to light the burners.

PROCESS: Heat Grill
  - Allow the grill to heat up for at least five minutes before cooking.

END:
  - The propane grill is now ready for cooking.

The refinancing party must demonstrate, to a lender, sufficient income to pay the monthly payment and refinancing costs., The refinancing party will need to submit an application for refinancing. The lender will also check the person's credit history and score. , If the refinancing is approved, your lender will notify you both. At this point, it is advisable to seek out an attorney to close the deal. The attorney can make sure the documentation is drafted properly. Make sure you receive copies of these records for your personal files. , You can contact other banks and lending institutions to try to find another lender that will approve the refinance. # Structured Summary of Loan Refinancing Process

## Start
START: Initiate the loan refinancing process to remove a name from the loan.

## Process Steps
PROCESS: The refinancing party must demonstrate sufficient income and ability to cover refinancing costs.
  INPUT: Monthly income details, refinancing costs.

PROCESS: The refinancing party submits an application for refinancing to a lender.
  INPUT: Refinancing application form.

PROCESS: Attach required documentation to the refinancing application.
  INPUT: Pay stubs, tax returns, credit card statements, bank statements, documentation of other loan obligations.

PROCESS: Lender checks the refinancing party's credit history and score.
  INPUT: Authorization to check credit history and score.

DECISION [IF]: Is the refinancing approved by the lender?
  - Yes: Proceed to notify both parties.
  - No: Contact other banks and lending institutions for refinancing.

PROCESS [IF YES]: Lender notifies both parties of the refinancing approval.
  OUTPUT: Notification of refinancing approval.

PROCESS: Seek out an attorney to close the refinancing deal.
  INPUT: Attorney services.

PROCESS: Attorney ensures proper drafting of documentation and removal of name from mortgage and property records.
  INPUT: Current mortgage and property records.

PROCESS: Receive copies of updated records for personal files.
  OUTPUT: Copies of updated mortgage and property records.

## Decision Steps for Rejection
PROCESS [IF NO]: Contact other banks and lending institutions to find a lender that will approve the refinance.
  INPUT: Refinancing application form and supporting documentation.

PROCESS: Submit applications to other lenders with required documentation.
  INPUT: Refinancing applications, pay stubs, tax returns, bank statements.

DECISION [IF]: Is the refinancing approved by any other lender?
  - Yes: Proceed to notify both parties and repeat steps after initial approval.
  - No: Continue to seek additional lenders or consider other options.

## End
END: The process concludes once the name is removed from the loan, either through the initial lender or an alternative lender.

wiki00829.title: How to Help Your Bi Friend Come Out
wiki00829.text: Tell them you have a positive attitude towards LGBT people. Try to find out if they also respect LGBT people. If you find out that your friend hates/disrespects LGBT people, don't try this method with them.; , If you are close enough, either of your houses could be the best option. Make sure that you two are alone. Don't select a place where others can invade your privacy. , Make sure that the atmosphere is calming and that neither of you have any unrelated stress. Try to make your friend feel safe with you. , Try to turn the conversation towards LGBT topics so that your question doesn't come from out of the blue. Then, you can either slip it quietly into conversation or ask outright. , Be patient and understanding. Understand that they may not actually be bisexual. If your friend tells you that they are not bisexual, don't press the topic too much. Either they are actually not bisexual or not ready to come out, and in both cases, pressing them on the topic will do more harm than good. , Their coming out to you is most likely a sign of trust, so don't betray that trust. Make sure that your language and movements are calm and friendly. Remind them that their identity is valid. Say you'll be there for them and back up your words with action.

wiki00011.title: How to Tame Frizzy Hair Quickly3
wiki00011.text: Brushing wet hair not only disrupts your hair's cuticles, it can also stretch hair, leading to breakage. Instead, gently squeeze your hair with a microfiber tower or old t-shirt and comb or finger comb it.Add a touch of your preferred conditional or anti-frizz product. , If you can't brush dry hair but still have to have a decent head of hair on a humid or brisk day, wet your hands and then finger-comb your hair to tackle any frizz and tame any tangles., This way, you are still giving your hair a lift without drying the hair shaft and hair tips. Look for a blow dryer with a diffuser, as this can limit the amount of heat being blasted on your roots. , As you blow dry your roots, spin around brush through your hair to help smooth the cuticles flat., Towel drying roughs up your hair's cuticle so instead of lying flat, it looks frizzy. Instead, use an absorbent microfiber towel to gently press water out of your hair., These products will only cook your curls, rather than hydrate them and lead to more frizz., These treatments can make your hair brittle and lead to breakage, so go easy on them or avoid them completely. You can use heat-protecters on your hair if you need to. Try a heatless way to straighten/curl your hair.

wiki00297.title: How to Fly First Class or Business Class for Less
wiki00297.text: Many online booking engines such as Orbitz and Travelocity have flexible date search tools which are very helpful in tracking down the lowest available airfare over a set period of time. Always select "lowest fare" when doing an airfare search online.; , First class full fare tickets are generally only bought by corporate travellers on business. , Add a Saturday night stay to reduce the fare further. , Many online booking engines such as Orbitz will allow you to check prices from nearby airports. , If you fly Virgin Atlantic Upper Class on a higher fare you will get complimentary chauffeur driven cars at both ends. For example, passengers to Los Angeles can be driven to any desired location in California. , Good deals can also be found booking overnight 'red-eye' flights - those comfortable first class seats will help you sleep better! , Some online agents are biased towards a single GDS so you will want to cover all your bases by checking elsewhere. Then double check any prices found directly at the airline websites. ,, Also use a specialist business class / first class consolidator who will have access to many unpublished airfares not available elsewhere. Generally, using a consolidator is optimal when booking around 4 to 8 weeks in advance.

wiki00836.title: How to Be Joyful3
wiki00836.text: Any time you interact with another person, take a second or two to acknowledge him. Because you never know what is going on in another person's life, a simple "hello" or "thank you" can go very far in making the person feel worthy and happy. In turn, the person's reaction may bring you joy with the response you get.Start off any interaction with a smile. It doesn't even need to be a big, toothy grin. A smile to a person you walk past may get a smile in return. Generally, the nicer you are to others, the more they will want you around and you'll experience the positive social consequences. Make eye contact whenever you can. Consider greeting others with a cheerful "hello." Remember to say "please" and "thank you." Saying these things and incorporating positive behaviors become a habit over time. Even at tough times, they can offer a glimmer of humanity to other people who are struggling. , Doing something nice for another person, like offering a compliment or paying for her lunch, can bring both of you a lot of joy.In any situation, consider making a small and kind gesture to another person. Not only will this bring the other person joy, but may also brighten your spirits. Keep in mind that you don't have to do something grand. Buying coffee for a friend or colleague who is having a hard time or giving someone a kind word can help the other personand yoube joyful., There are a lot of people in the world who are less fortunate than you. They may not have a home, job, or their health. Giving some time to these people can give them a glimmer of hope and joy and make you feel great, too.Offer your time to a health facility or organization that provides aid to those less fortunate than you. Consider working at a place where your skills may be especially welcome. For example, if you like to paint, you could volunteer to paint with sick children or the elderly. You could also help individuals living in shelters develop their job skills.

- Assemblies with ≥ 2-hour fire-resistance rating

- DECISION [IF]: Is the choice solid masonry?
  - Yes: Use reinforced concrete not less than four inches thick.
  - No: Proceed to next decision.

  - Yes: Use hollow masonry not less than 12 inches thick.
  - No: Proceed to next decision.

  - Yes: Ensure it has a listed fire-resistance rating of not less than two hours.
  - No: Proceed to next decision.

  - Yes: Ensure the assembly has not less than a two-hour fire-resistance rating.
  - No: Review wall specifications.

- Use horizontal and vertical load-bearing protected metal supports with not less than a two-hour fire-resistance rating.

- Pull the cables tight before pouring the concrete.
- Release the cables as the concrete cures.

PROCESS: Utilize post-tensioned concrete units.
- Pull one end of the cable tight after pouring the concrete.

OUTPUT: A completed structure that meets the ISO Class 6 IBC Type IA requirements.

END: Construction system process complete.

wiki01105.title: How to Fix Poor Soil Drainage2
wiki01105.text: Water follows gravity, so if it's collecting in a depression, raise the ground in that area. First, rake up the affected topsoil with a landscape rake so it mixes well with the soil to be added. Then collect soil from a higher site and use your rake to redistribute it over the low-lying area, tilling it well to mix it with the original soil. Fill the depression almost all the way, with about 2 inches (5 cm) to spare. Fill the last two inches by laying sod so its roots prevent the soil from washing away.Remember to keep the slope of your lawn running downward from your house, not toward it. Your lawn's slope should ideally lower by a couple inches (5 cm) every ten feet (3 m) from your house. , If the roof of your house or shed is adding water to a certain spot in your hard, redirect the water by installing water gutters and drains. Definitely do this if water is pooling directly alongside your house, since it may get into the foundation and create mold and cracks. Make sure you place your drains where the ground slopes away from your house so you don't create a new problem while solving the old one.Installing a rain barrel to collect water from your gutters is a great way to minimize the amount that your lawn has to absorb. It's also a great no-waste practice, as the rainwater can be used to water plants. , Map out a creek bed that will carry water downhill from the affected area. Remove 12 to 15 inches (30 to 38 cm) of soil along this course. Compact the ground so the bed is flat and the sides are angled up and outward, away from the bed, so surrounding water flows in. Cover the bed and sides with landscape fabric to keep weeds and grass from growing. Then add a inch (1.25 cm) layer of pea gravel over the bed.Be mindful of neighbors when plotting your creek's course. Diverting standing water might solve your drainage issues, but flooding their yard may create a whole new problem.

# Structured Summary of Lawn Drainage Improvement Blog Post

## System Overview
The system is designed to address and improve drainage issues in a yard or lawn area. The aim is to prevent water from collecting in depressions or pooling near structures, which could lead to foundation damage, mold, or unwanted water runoff to neighboring properties. The system includes steps for raising ground levels, redirecting water flow, and installing mechanisms to manage excess water.

### START: Begin the process of improving lawn drainage.

### PROCESS: Assess the area with water collection issues.
  - INPUT: Identify the low-lying area where water is collecting.

### PROCESS: Prepare the low-lying area for soil addition.
  - Use a landscape rake to loosen the topsoil in the affected area.
  - OUTPUT: Loosened and aerated topsoil ready for mixing.

### PROCESS: Collect and add new soil to the depression.
  - INPUT: Soil from a higher site.
  - Use a rake to distribute the new soil over the low-lying area.
  - OUTPUT: Raised ground level with mixed soils.

### DECISION: Is the depression filled to within 2 inches (5 cm) from the surface?
  - IF YES: Proceed to lay sod.
  - ELSE: Continue adding and mixing soil until the level is correct.

### PROCESS: Finish filling with sod.
  - INPUT: Sod to cover the last 2 inches (5 cm).
  - Lay sod over the raised area to prevent erosion.
  - OUTPUT: Stabilized soil surface with sod.

### DECISION: Does the lawn slope need adjustment?
  - IF YES: Adjust the slope to ensure it runs downward from the house.
  - ELSE: Proceed to water management installations.

### PROCESS: Install water gutters and drains if necessary.
  - DECISION: Is water pooling directly alongside the house?
    - IF YES: Install water gutters and drains to redirect water.
    - ELSE: Evaluate other water management options.

### PROCESS: Place drains in areas where the ground slopes away from the house.
  - OUTPUT: Safely redirected water flow away from the foundation.

### PROCESS: Install a rain barrel to collect water from gutters.
  - INPUT: A rain barrel.
  - OUTPUT: Collected rainwater for plant irrigation.

### PROCESS: Design a creek bed to carry water away from affected areas.
  - Map out a creek bed path downhill.
  - Remove 12 to 15 inches (30 to 38 cm) of soil along the path.
  - OUTPUT: Excavated creek bed path.

### PROCESS: Prepare the creek bed for water flow.
  - Compact the ground for a flat creek bed with angled sides.
  - Cover with landscape fabric to prevent weed and grass growth.
  - Add a layer of pea gravel over the fabric.
  - OUTPUT: Completed creek bed designed for drainage.

### DECISION: Does the creek bed direct water towards neighboring yards?
  - IF YES: Adjust the creek's course to avoid flooding neighbors.
  - ELSE: Finish the creek bed installation.

### END: Drainage improvement process completed.
```

# Comforter Freshening and Cleaning System

## System Overview
This system provides methods for freshening and cleaning a comforter. It includes a homemade freshening solution, use of a steam cleaner, and options for washing at home or professional dry cleaning based on the level of soiling. 

## Process Steps

### START:
- Begin the comforter freshening and cleaning process.

### INPUT: Freshening Solution Ingredients
- 1 cup (236.6 ml) warm water
- 1 teaspoon (5 ml) borax
- 1 teaspoon (5 ml) oxygen bleach
- 3 drops lavender essential oil (optional)

- Mix warm water, borax, oxygen bleach, and lavender essential oil in a bowl.

- Soak a washcloth in the freshening solution.

- Obtain the comforter that needs freshening.

- IF Yes: Proceed to steam cleaning.

- Fill a steam cleaner with distilled water.

- Heat the steam cleaner to produce steam.
- Run the steaming wand over the surface of the comforter.

- Comforter should be refreshed and free from bad odors.

### DECISION: Is the comforter heavily soiled?
- IF Yes: Consider professional dry cleaning.
- ELSE No: Proceed to wash at home.

### DECISION: Choose Professional Dry Cleaning
- IF Yes: Take comforter to a professional dry cleaner.
- ELSE No: Wash the comforter at home.

### END: Professional Dry Cleaning
- Comforter is cleaned by professionals.

### INPUT: Washing Machine Settings
- Set washing machine to cold water and low heat.

### PROCESS: Wash Comforter at Home
- Wash the comforter in the washing machine as any other garment or linen.

- Comforter is cleaned, hoping it holds up to the washing process.

# Shoulder Stand (Sarvangasana) Pose Instruction System

## START:
- Begin by lying on a mat with your back flat against the floor.

## PROCESS: Prepare for Pose
- INPUT: Position yourself on the mat.
- Ensure your hands are by your side.

## PROCESS: Initiate Lift
- In one fluid motion, lift your buttocks, hips, and back off of the ground.

## PROCESS: Support Your Back
- Use your elbows and hands to support your back.
- INPUT: Adjust your elbows and upper arms to be flat against the floor.

## PROCESS: Position Hands
- Move your hands closer to your shoulder blades for additional support.

## PROCESS: Align Legs and Spine
- Keep your legs and spine straight by pressing down with your elbows and hands.
- OUTPUT: Body alignment ready for full pose.

  - Yes: Continue to the next step.
  - No: End the pose and rest.

- Lift your heels upwards as if trying to place your feet flat against the ceiling.

## PROCESS: Position Toes and Sternum
- Bring your big toes over your nose and head, pointing your toes up.
- Press your sternum toward your chin, avoiding neck strain.

- Maintain the posture without shaking or swaying.

- Hold the posture for 30 to 60 seconds, breathing deeply throughout.

## PROCESS: Release the Pose
- With palms facing down, place your hands on the floor.

## PROCESS: Lower Spine Gradually
- Slowly bring down your spine, vertebra by vertebra, keeping your head stationary.

## PROCESS: Lower Legs
- Gently lower your legs to the floor to exit the position.

## PROCESS: Rest
- Rest for up to 60 seconds after exiting the pose.

## DECISION: [IF] Do you wish to repeat the pose?
  - Yes: Return to the START and repeat the steps.
  - No: Proceed to END.

## END:
- The shoulder stand pose sequence is complete.

wiki01225.title: How to Meet Someone's New Dog3
wiki01225.text: Be sure to read the dog's body language carefully to gauge whether or not it wants to interact with you. Any signs of fear or unease should be recognized and respected; you can always try approaching the dog on another occasion when it might be more responsive. Some observable signs that you should back off could include:growling bared teeth flattened ears aggressive eye contact crouching with muscles tensed and tail stiff , Be sure to avoid approaching the dog if it is eating or chewing on a bone or treat. Your approach might be seen as an attempt to take away its food, which will almost certainly be met with a negative response. Wait until the dog is finished eating, or simply leave the dog alone altogether., If your encounter makes the dog overexcited and it begins biting your hands or jumping on you, withdraw yourself immediately. Turn away from the dog and cross your arms, signalling your withdrawal from the interaction. Ignore the dog until it calms down; if its owner has just adopted it, it will likely still be in a process of behavioral adjustment and need to be prompted to calm down.

wiki00786.title: How to Buy a Good Backpack3
wiki00786.text: Look for backpacks that will be the right size for your daily needs. Using an overly large backpack will make it more likely you will overfill it.Think about how many books or electronics you need to carry. Don't try to carry more than 15% of your body weight. Rolling backpacks can be a great alternative if you have heavy loads. , Look for padded shoulders and try backpacks on. Two strapped bags are better than single strapped, because they distribute weight better. Try backpacks on, if not shopping online and remember the bottom should rest on the curve of your lower back. , Loose threads and careless stitching can be dead giveaways of bad quality. A backpack can give years of good use and you want to make sure your investment is durable. Inspect the fabric for any raw edges. , Backpacks come in all types and extra features can be either useful or unnecessary. If you carry a lot of small items such as pencils, keys or snacks, you may want extra pockets to easily access them. Some bags have padded pockets for computer tablets and laptops. Opt for a more basic backpack, if you don't need these extra compartments. , Think about where you will be taking your new backpack. If you are going off to college, you may want a bag that will carry heavy books, but also show some personal style. If you're traveling in urban areas, you will want a streamlined, modern style.These bags typically have hidden pockets that do not look bulky.

wiki01252.text: Diamonds seem very meaningful to many people as they symbolize commitment and lifelong togetherness. If you have ethical objections to diamonds, or if they're out of your budget, try a moissanite gem. Opal represents a lot of positives, such as spontaneity, lightness, and creativity. Rose quartz is supposedly associated with the removal of the negative.

wiki00932.text: On some phones, there will be a physical button that takes you straight to your contacts. That will be indicated by a label on the main menu that says contacts, near the button that opens it. On some, you'll have to scroll through the menu to find the contacts application. Smartphones will have an app for contacts, or it will be an option in the phone menu. , Once you've opened your contacts, find the name of the person you'd like to send a message to. You should be able to either search (entering the first letters of the person's name) or scroll to find who you'd like to reach. On a non-smartphone, you'll hit the "Okay" or "Select" button. On a smartphone, you'll generally just tap the person's name to open the contact details. , Look for something that says "send message" or, on a smart phone, a message icon (usually a cartoon-like speech bubble icon). Selecting this option should take you to a window where you can compose your message. Type your message and select send.

wiki01015.title: How to Trash Talk1
wiki01015.text: If you are only joking around with your friends on the soccer field, meaningless jokes are an effective way to go. Keep it informal and light. On the opposite end of the trash-talk spectrum, if you are engaged in a competitive sporting event against people you don't know, you may need to focus more on serious boasts and downplay the humor. For a meaningless joke, tell a friend that they're like a bundle of firewood, "because they're always getting burned."For a more serious boast, say, "Should I give you my autograph now, or later?"; , Whether you're competing online or in person, you need to "read the room" and determine if trash talking is an appropriate tactic. If the other players seem to be focused on projecting respect and sportsmanship, your trash talk may be seen as rude. The same rule applies in online forumsif other participants enjoy trash talk or are already engaging in it, go ahead and join in. If the crowd is more conservative and prefers a quieter atmosphere, you should avoid bothering competitors with your trash talking. , Some sports, such as boxing and wrestling, are aggressive, in-your-face competitions. These environments encourage trash talk, as it increases the entertainment for spectators and allows the fighters to get under one another's skin. Other sports, like tennis or baseball, are seen are more "gentlemanly," and discourage trash talk.Even online, some competitive games are more appropriate forums for trash talking. (Call of Duty and similar games are infamous examples.) Until you're familiar with the gaming community, avoid stepping in with aggressive trash talk. Also if you're playing a light-hearted video game with family, avoid trash talk. For example, if you're playing Wii Sports with a young nephew or your grandmother, do not trash talk.

wiki00583.title: How to Earn 100 Dollars in One Week (for Kids)6
wiki00583.text: If your parents, family members, or neighbors are having a garage sale, get in on it! Ask if you can have part of a table and have whatever money you make from the items you sell. Now the question: what are you willing to part with? Don't try to sell your artwork, your dolls with one arm and one eye, or your Legos that you put into the blender. No one will buy them. Just look for things that are still in good condition but that you no longer use. Someone else could use and love them! , There are several places that will take your things, put a price on them, and then give you most of the money when they sell. So gather up the things you don't need, ask Mom to take you, and head to the nearest consignment shop. Consider selling some of your old things that you don't want anymore on eBay or a similar website. Have you been collecting anything that you have doubles of or don't want anymore? , This one takes a little bit of know-how and creativity. But if you have those two things, why not give it a shot? Consider a couple of these ideas: Can you make a mean cinnamon roll? Consider asking your neighbors if they'd like homemade cinnamon rolls delivered to their door on Sundays. People who live alone may love the treat, never bothering to bake for themselves! Have a garden? Consider growing fruits or vegetables. Are you good at woodworking, sewing, or crafting in general? Homemade things are all the rage. If there's something you can create that would be great for gift-giving, make it and sell it!
